## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] HACS validation
- [ ] Hassfest
- [ ] Tested on a real supported media player when playback behavior changed

## Safety and documentation

- [ ] No audio, ZIP archive, scraped catalog, credential, token, or private HA data is included.
- [ ] Source provenance and rights were reviewed if a recording link changed.
- [ ] `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` describe every public behavior change.
- [ ] One-device/single-entry behavior and partial-failure isolation are preserved.
